comment: Sources checked daily by scripts/watchdog.mjs. Add or remove entries freely — each needs a unique url. 'note' explains what a change might mean for the curated content.

sources.name: DILG Full Disclosure Policy Portal
sources.note: LGU budgets, procurement, and financial reports. New disclosures may need new records in content/transparency/disclosures.yaml.

sources.name: Commission on Audit
sources.note: Annual audit reports (AFR) for the province and municipalities.

sources.name: PhilGEPS
sources.note: Government procurement notices and contract awards.

sources.name: DPWH Infrastructure Projects Portal
sources.note: Contracts and progress reports for national public works.

sources.name: Sumbong sa Pangulo
sources.note: Citizen reports and inspections of flood control projects.

sources.name: BetterGov.ph Transparency
sources.note: Independent records of DPWH projects and budgets.

sources.name: Love the Philippines — Marinduque
sources.note: Civic mirror of DPWH, PhilGEPS, and DBM records by place.

sources.name: Provincial Government of Marinduque
sources.note: Official site; publishes annual accomplishment reports and press releases.

sources.name: DBM COMPASS National Tax Allotment
sources.note: Published national tax allotment data by fiscal year.

sources.name: BetterGov.ph Budget API (FY 2027)
sources.note: Live source for the national budget page. Changes here affect what visitors see at runtime; curated YAML only needs review when the budget moves from proposal to enactment.
